request.style: English, musical theatre duet, a bright tenor as the angel and a clear soprano as the young woman singing in turn and then together, theatre orchestra with strings, woodwinds and harp, storytelling with dramatic swells, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Do not be afraid, Mary
You have found favor with God
You will bear a son and call him Jesus
And his kingdom will never end

[Verse]
How can this be, how can this be
When I have never known a man
I am only a girl from Nazareth
How can this be his plan

[Chorus]
Nothing is impossible with God
Nothing is impossible with God

[Verse]
The Holy Spirit will come upon you
The power of the Most High will overshadow you
And your cousin Elizabeth in her old age
Is with child, for nothing is too hard

[Verse]
I am the servant of the Lord
Let it be to me according to your word
I am the servant of the Lord
Let it be to me as you have said

[Chorus]
Nothing is impossible with God
Nothing is impossible with God
